# Milkdown Docs Cache

A local mirror of the official Milkdown documentation, kept in this repo so
Claude Code (and humans) can `Grep` the docs while working on the editor.

## Why it exists

`apps/writer-tauri/` is built on Milkdown 7.20.0. We touch a wide API surface
(Core ctx, plugins, ProseMirror interop, custom node/mark schemas), and
searching the live docs through `WebFetch` returns a lossy LLM-processed
summary that can't be cross-referenced across pages. A local markdown copy
lets us do exact-string searches and pin the docs to the dependency version.

## What's in here

- `guide/` — conceptual guides (architecture, commands, prosemirror-api, …)
- `plugin/` — plugin authoring (composable-plugins, plugins-101, examples, …)
- `recipes/` — framework recipes (react, vue, nextjs, …)
- `api/` — auto-generated API reference per Milkdown package
- `blog/` — official blog posts
- `INDEX.md` — entry point with one link per page

Every page begins with frontmatter:

```yaml
---
source: https://milkdown.dev/docs/...
fetched: YYYY-MM-DD
milkdown_version: 7.20.0
title: "..."
---
```

## Build / runtime impact

None. `docs/` is not a Vite or Tauri entry point — these files never ship in
`dist/` or the Tauri bundle. They exist purely for development-time reference.

## Refreshing the cache

```sh
node scripts/refresh-vendor-docs.mjs
```

The script reads `https://milkdown.dev/sitemap.xml`, extracts markdown from
each page's Next.js `__NEXT_DATA__` payload, and falls back to the GitHub raw
source for blog pages (whose markdown isn't embedded server-side). It is
idempotent; rerun whenever Milkdown publishes new docs or you bump the
dependency version. Remember to update `milkdown_version` in
`scripts/refresh-vendor-docs.mjs` when bumping Milkdown.

## Do not hand-edit

These files are regenerated by the refresh script. Hand-edits will be
overwritten on the next refresh. File issues/improvements upstream at
<https://github.com/Milkdown/website>.
